visualReview.notes: Inspected all48 current source/shared/medium-fi/native views during one continuous author/build/inspect/fix pass. No removed upper storey, Salutation towers/canopy, independent Sultan Ahmed III fountain, copied inscriptions/tughra or furnished guard rooms. The flat library stages judge appearance; the separate original PMTiles scene judges native placement.
